lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately vertical columns posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with circular blobs to form a rectangular grid-like configuration across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features running longitudinally along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs within the visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located along the anterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-luminance spotting distributed across the dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin.
